description: This file provides a fake clock implementation for testing purposes within the Kubernetes project, including fake passive clocks, fake clocks with timers and tickers, and related utilities.

classes.name: FakePassiveClock
classes.description: A fake implementation of PassiveClock that returns an arbitrary time.

classes.name: FakeClock
classes.description: A fake implementation of clock.Clock that allows manual control over time for testing.

classes.name: IntervalClock
classes.description: A deprecated clock that advances time by a fixed interval each call to Now.

classes.name: fakeTimer
classes.description: A fake implementation of clock.Timer based on FakeClock.

methods.name: Since
methods.description: Returns the duration since a given timestamp.

methods.name: SetTime
methods.description: Sets the fake clock to a specific time.

methods.name: After
methods.description: Returns a channel that will receive the current time after a duration.

methods.name: NewTimer
methods.description: Creates a new fake timer that fires after a duration.

methods.name: AfterFunc
methods.description: Creates a timer that executes a callback after a duration.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Creates a ticker channel that ticks at specified intervals.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Advances the fake clock by a specified duration and triggers waiters.

methods.name: Sleep
methods.description: Advances the clock by a duration, similar to time.Sleep.

methods.name: HasWaiters
methods.description: Returns true if there are waiters pending on the clock.

methods.name: Waiters
methods.description: Returns the number of waiters on the clock.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Returns the channel that signals when the timer has fired.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the timer to a new duration.
